papers.title: Optimal Linear Regression Without a Variance
papers.abstract: We study high-probability linear regression in the infinite variance regime, wherecthe regression noise has only a finite conditional $α$-moment $ν$ for some unknown $α\in(1,2)$, and the covariates may only have finite moments up to a given order (e.g., 4th moment). We give a black-box reduction that converts finite-variance regression procedures into weak-moment procedures. The reduction is based on empirical residual pruning and is agnostic to the moment exponent, the noise scale, the covariance, and the design moment. Under a finite fourth-moment condition on the covariates, any finite-variance subroutine attaining the sub-Gaussian rate yields the following when the number of samples $n$ is above a suitably defined threshold: Without knowing $α$ or $ν$, we have with probability at least $1-δ$ that $ \|\widehatθ-θ^*\|_Σ \lesssim_α ν^{1/α} \big(\frac{d+\log(1/δ)}{n}\big)^{\frac{α-1}α}, $ where $d$ is the dimension, $Σ$ is the covariate covariance matrix, and $\|v\|_Σ:=(v^\topΣv)^{1/2}$. We further prove a matching minimax lower bound that holds under the same conditions. The reduction is computationally efficient whenever the finite-variance subroutine is. We also obtain a distribution-free prediction guarantee under a bounded raw $α$-moment assumption on the response, and give an analogous $α$-agnostic reduction for mean estimation.
papers.summary_zh: 本文研究无限方差情形下的高概率线性回归，其中噪声仅具有未知阶数α∈(1,2)的有限条件α矩，协变量也可能仅有有限阶矩。作者提出一种基于经验残差剪枝的黑盒归约方法，将有限方差回归流程转化为弱矩流程，且对矩指数、噪声尺度、协方差和设计矩均不敏感。在协变量四阶矩有限条件下，该方法达到与极小极大下界匹配的收敛速率，无需知道α或ν，并可推广到无分布预测保证和均值估计。
papers.summary_en: This paper studies high-probability linear regression in the infinite-variance regime, where the noise has only a finite conditional α-moment for an unknown α∈(1,2) and covariates may have only finite moments up to a given order. The authors propose a black-box reduction based on empirical residual pruning that converts finite-variance regression procedures into weak-moment procedures, agnostic to the moment exponent, noise scale, covariance, and design moment. Under a finite fourth-moment condition on covariates, the reduction achieves a rate matching a minimax lower bound without knowing α or ν, and extends to distribution-free prediction guarantees and an analogous reduction for mean estimation.
highlights_zh: 残差剪枝黑盒归约，α无关
达到极小极大最优收敛速率
计算高效，可推广至均值估计

papers.title: Non-penetrating World Models
papers.abstract: We study a new problem of preventing object penetration in interactive video world models. To understand how existing models handle this, we introduce NoPeBench, a benchmark that evaluates how world models respond to physical obstacles. Our evaluation reveals that none of the open-source models can reliably prevent such failures. Surprisingly, however, these models already encode the information needed to predict such violations. We find that the hidden states of diffusion transformers (DiTs) can predict whether a candidate action will penetrate an obstacle. Building on this, we introduce NoPeWorld, a lightweight framework that detects and prevents penetration. Specifically, we train a small prediction head on top of a frozen DiT's hidden states to read out if a candidate action is safe or not. Unsafe actions are then replaced with safe ones that best preserve the original intent. Despite its simplicity, NoPeWorld substantially reduces the physical violation rate, averaged over six video world models, from 74% to 16%. Remarkably, our method shows zero-shot generalization to open-domain imagery, third-person viewpoints, and moving obstacles. We publicly release our code, the NoPeBench benchmark, and model weights. Project Page: https://nopeworld.github.io .
papers.summary_zh: 交互式视频世界模型在生成过程中常出现物体穿透物理障碍的失败，现有开源模型均无法可靠避免。作者提出NoPeBench基准评估该问题，并发现冻结DiT的隐藏状态已蕴含穿透预测信息，据此设计NoPeWorld：在隐藏状态上训练小型预测头判断候选动作安全性，并将不安全动作替换为最保留原意图的安全动作。该方法将六个视频世界模型的平均物理违规率从74%降至16%，并零样本泛化到开放域图像、第三人称视角和移动障碍物。
papers.summary_en: Interactive video world models frequently suffer from object penetration through physical obstacles, and no open-source model reliably prevents such failures. The authors introduce NoPeBench to evaluate this issue and find that frozen DiT hidden states already encode penetration-predictive information, enabling NoPeWorld, a lightweight framework that trains a small prediction head to classify candidate actions as safe or unsafe and replaces unsafe actions with safe ones preserving original intent. NoPeWorld reduces the average physical violation rate across six video world models from 74% to 16% and generalizes zero-shot to open-domain imagery, third-person viewpoints, and moving obstacles.
highlights_zh: 冻结DiT隐藏状态可预测穿透
违规率从74%降至16%
零样本泛化多场景

papers.title: A Methodologically Rigorous Benchmark of Linear Regression,RNN, and LSTM for S&P 500 Forecasting:Identifying Sources of Performance Inflation in Financial DeepLearning
papers.abstract: This study examines one-day-ahead forecasting of the S&P 500 closing level using a 2006-2025 dataset that includes fundamental price data, macroeconomic indicators, and engineered technical features. We benchmark three model families, namely linear regression, vanilla recurrent neural networks (RNN), and long short-term memory networks (LSTM), within a unified preprocessing and chronological evaluation pipeline. A central contribution of this work is a methodological audit of common practices in the deep-learning-for-stock-prediction literature. We identify three sources of result inflation that frequently appear in published methodologies: wavelet-denoised evaluation targets, the absence of a naive persistence baseline, and best-of-N replicate reporting. We then re-evaluate all model families under a corrected protocol that controls for each. Performance is reported using root mean squared error, mean absolute percentage error, and the Pearson correlation coefficient, averaged across N = 30 independent replicates per configuration. We compare models on accuracy, stability across replicates, and architectural depth sensitivity, using the naive persistence forecast (predicting today's close as tomorrow's close) as a primary baseline against which all candidate models must demonstrate improvement.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对标普500指数提前一天收盘价预测中深度学习文献常见的结果虚高问题，使用2006-2025年包含价格、宏观指标和技术特征的数据集进行系统基准测试。作者在统一预处理与时间序列评估流程下对比线性回归、vanilla RNN和LSTM，并审计出小波去噪评估目标、缺失朴素持续性基线、best-of-N重复报告三个结果膨胀来源，随后在控制这些因素的修正协议下以30次独立重复重新评估。结果表明需以朴素持续性预测为主要基线衡量模型改进，并综合RMSE、MAPE和Pearson相关系数比较精度、稳定性与架构深度敏感性，为金融深度学习预测提供了更严谨的评估范式。
papers.summary_en: This study addresses one-day-ahead S&P 500 closing-level forecasting using a 2006-2025 dataset with fundamental price data, macroeconomic indicators, and engineered technical features. It benchmarks linear regression, vanilla RNN, and LSTM within a unified preprocessing and chronological evaluation pipeline, while auditing three sources of result inflation common in the literature: wavelet-denoised evaluation targets, absence of a naive persistence baseline, and best-of-N replicate reporting, then re-evaluating all models under a corrected protocol with N=30 independent replicates. Performance is reported via RMSE, MAPE, and Pearson correlation, comparing accuracy, replicate stability, and architectural depth sensitivity against the naive persistence forecast as the primary baseline, thereby offering a more rigorous evaluation standard for financial deep learning forecasting.
highlights_zh: 审计三类结果膨胀来源并修正评估协议
30次重复下以持续性基线衡量改进
为金融深度学习预测提供严谨基准
highlights_en: Audits three inflation sources and corrects protocol
Rigorous benchmark for financial deep learning

papers.title: On the Complete Feature Set for ADHD Classification in Children and Adolescents Based on EEG Signals
papers.abstract: Attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder is a neurodevelopmental condition that can affect attention, activity and impulse control. Electroencephalography (EEG) records brain activity as children and adolescents perform cognitive tasks. However, comparing features derived from these recordings requires consistent signal preparation, shared analysis windows and documented quality decisions. We curated 669 existing BALLADEER recordings from 156 participants across five task conditions so that researchers can compare seven EEG feature families on the same time intervals for each participant and task. The dataset links continuous signals to precomputed measurements from 115 feature definitions or templates and records the quality decisions made for each recording. Analyses must still account for repeated measurements within participants, residual artefacts and differences between acquisition systems. Technical validation covered signal integrity, numerical checks on feature estimators and completeness of the released files. In every task, the median proportion of recording time retained after preprocessing was 100%. To illustrate reuse, we report saved participant-held-out evaluations comparing XGBoost using all seven families on eight-second windows with a predictor based only on recruitment-group prevalence in the training fold. Recruitment-group discrimination was stronger in Robots than in the three Slackline conditions. These descriptive results from overlapping cohorts do not establish diagnostic validity. The dataset, curation software and aggregate results for the predictive example are publicly available.
papers.summary_zh: ADHD分类研究缺乏统一信号预处理、分析窗口和质量决策标准，导致不同EEG特征难以公平比较。作者整理156名参与者、5种任务条件下的669段BALLADEER记录，在同一时间区间上计算7类共115种特征定义，并公开数据、整理软件和质量记录。各任务预处理后保留时间中位数均为100%，用XGBoost在8秒窗口上的留出评估显示Robots任务组间区分强于Slackline任务，但结果仅为描述性、不构成诊断效度。
papers.summary_en: EEG-based ADHD classification studies lack consistent signal preparation, shared analysis windows and documented quality decisions, making feature comparisons unreliable. The authors curated 669 BALLADEER recordings from 156 participants across five task conditions, computed seven EEG feature families (115 definitions) on identical time intervals, and released the data, curation software and quality records. Median retained recording time after preprocessing was 100% in every task, and a participant-held-out XGBoost example on eight-second windows showed stronger recruitment-group discrimination in Robots than in the three Slackline conditions, though these descriptive results do not establish diagnostic validity.
highlights_zh: 统一窗口下对齐7类115种EEG特征
预处理后保留时间中位数达100%
公开数据可复用但非诊断验证

papers.title: MemOnce: A Scalable Memory Architecture for Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Deploying large language models (LLMs) in long-horizon and continual interactions requires maintaining reusable memory states for future inference, posing challenges for existing architectures. Standard Transformers accumulate layer-wise, token-level KV caches, incurring linear GPU memory growth and quadratic computational complexity as the context expands. In contrast, linear-time architectures compress history into fixed-size states, but struggle to retain fine-grained details. We introduce MemOnce, a foundation architecture that learns scalable memory states for language models. MemOnce is based on two core designs: (a) Memory encoder-decoder: it caches only a small subset of final-layer hidden states as compact memory representations and dynamically decodes them back into KV caches for attention layers; (b) Memory sparse attention: for each continual input, MemOnce adaptively retrieves relevant memory representations, with the sparse indices computed only once across layers. Coupling these two designs enables efficient on-the-fly memory loading and KV cache decoding, drastically reducing the GPU memory footprint and achieving linear-time complexity. We conduct extensive experiments to show that MemOnce outperforms Transformers and other architectures across varying model sizes, context lengths, and training paradigms (pretraining and post-training adaptation). In particular, adapting Qwen3.5-4B with MemOnce reduces memory state cache by 1313$\times$ and prefill latency by 6.9$\times$ at 1M context, and improves throughput by 3.5$\times$ and overall memory performance by +5.77%. Finally, MemOnce generalizes zero-shot to downstream representation tasks, achieving competitive results against specialized models.
papers.summary_zh: 部署大语言模型进行长时程与持续交互时，标准Transformer的KV缓存随上下文增长导致GPU显存线性膨胀和计算二次复杂度，而线性时间架构虽压缩历史却难以保留细粒度细节。MemOnce提出记忆编码器-解码器（仅缓存少量末层隐状态作为紧凑记忆并动态解码回KV缓存）与记忆稀疏注意力（跨层仅计算一次稀疏索引以自适应检索相关记忆）两项核心设计，实现高效即时记忆加载与KV缓存解码。实验表明MemOnce在多种模型规模、上下文长度和训练范式下优于Transformer等架构，在1M上下文下将Qwen3.5-4B的记忆状态缓存减少1313倍、预填充延迟降低6.9倍、吞吐提升3.5倍、整体记忆性能提升5.77%，并可零样本泛化到下游表示任务。
papers.summary_en: Deploying LLMs for long-horizon and continual interactions requires reusable memory states, but standard Transformers accumulate token-level KV caches with linear GPU memory growth and quadratic complexity, while linear-time architectures compress history into fixed-size states yet struggle to retain fine-grained details. MemOnce introduces a memory encoder-decoder that caches only a small subset of final-layer hidden states as compact memory and dynamically decodes them back into KV caches, plus memory sparse attention that adaptively retrieves relevant memory with sparse indices computed only once across layers, enabling efficient on-the-fly memory loading and KV cache decoding with linear-time complexity. Experiments across model sizes, context lengths, and training paradigms show MemOnce outperforms Transformers and other architectures; adapting Qwen3.5-4B reduces memory state cache by 1313x and prefill latency by 6.9x at 1M context, improves throughput by 3.5x and overall memory performance by +5.77%, and generalizes zero-shot to downstream representation tasks competitively with specialized models.
highlights_zh: 紧凑记忆编码解码+跨层单次稀疏检索
1M上下文缓存降1313倍、延迟降6.9倍
长时程交互高效部署，细节保留待验证

papers.title: TEA-Bench-BR: Can Coding Agents Turn a Branching Clinical Specification into Correct Code?
papers.abstract: Coding agents increasingly implement rules written by domain experts, and bugs in such code are silent: it runs and returns a plausible answer. We introduce TEA-Bench-BR, a benchmark built on the Brazilian pathway for early autism (TEA) screening: three fictitious instruments with the structure of real ones, a multi-professional referral flow, and export to FHIR R4 with the national RNDS profiles, all specified in Portuguese. A generator samples each task's parameters (144 tasks, 6,798 hidden cases), and the hidden cases kill all 1,955 non-equivalent mutants of the reference. With Gemma 4 as the agent, the 12B solves 38.0% of single-instrument tasks and none at the FHIR level; the 31B solves 77.8%, 85.2% and 78.7% at levels 1 to 3 and passes over 99% of the hidden cases, its remaining failures mostly in input validation rather than clinical decisions. With the same tasks in English, the 31B solves 57.4% at level 3, as its code validates an identifier less often; the 12B's, more often. The 12B misses 10.10% of the cases that call for referral; the 31B, 0.02%. A contamination probe on a modified PHQ-9 finds no error that follows the original rules.
papers.summary_zh: 领域专家编写的临床规则代码存在静默错误：代码能运行并返回看似合理的结果，但实际有误。作者构建了TEA-Bench-BR基准，基于巴西早期自闭症筛查路径，包含三个虚构量表、多专业转诊流程及符合RNDS规范的FHIR R4导出，全部用葡萄牙语描述，并生成144个任务、6798个隐藏用例以杀死全部1955个非等价变异体。Gemma 4 31B在三个层级上分别解决77.8%、85.2%、78.7%的任务并通过超99%隐藏用例，剩余失败多属输入校验而非临床决策，12B漏检10.10%的转诊用例而31B仅0.02%，表明该基准能有效暴露编码代理在临床规则实现中的静默缺陷。
papers.summary_en: Coding agents increasingly implement domain-expert rules, where bugs are silent: the code runs and returns a plausible answer. We introduce TEA-Bench-BR, a benchmark built on the Brazilian early autism (TEA) screening pathway with three fictitious instruments, a multi-professional referral flow, and FHIR R4 export using national RNDS profiles, all specified in Portuguese; a generator samples 144 tasks with 6,798 hidden cases that kill all 1,955 non-equivalent mutants of the reference. With Gemma 4 as the agent, the 12B solves 38.0% of single-instrument tasks and none at the FHIR level, while the 31B solves 77.8%, 85.2% and 78.7% at levels 1 to 3 and passes over 99% of hidden cases, with remaining failures mostly in input validation rather than clinical decisions; the 12B misses 10.10% of referral cases versus 0.02% for the 31B, and a contamination probe on a modified PHQ-9 finds no error following the original rules.
highlights_zh: 基于真实临床路径的变异体杀伤基准
31B通过超99%隐藏用例
暴露静默错误与转诊漏检风险

papers.title: DiTraR: Diverse Scorers and Transcript-Guided Re-ranking for Video Corpus Moment Retrieval
papers.abstract: Video corpus moment retrieval asks a system to find, in a large collection of untrimmed videos with subtitles, the video and the time interval that a natural-language query describes. We find that most top-ranked errors of a strong corpus-level scorer come from choosing the wrong video, not from imprecise boundaries, and that re-weighting the evidence the scorer already uses does not fix them. We present DiTraR, which addresses video selection from two complementary directions. A witness-interval scorer decomposes the query into probes and scores every candidate interval of every corpus video exactly; a multi-scorer energy ensemble averages the energies of independently trained scorers before one exhaustive search; and a transcript verifier, a frozen language model that reads the time-stamped dialogue of the highest-ranked videos, re-orders the moments without changing their boundaries. With all settings frozen on development data and a single evaluation, DiTraR reaches 24.36 and 13.55 R@1 at IoU 0.5 and 0.7 on the TVR validation split. The ensemble improves queries about visual content, the verifier improves queries about dialogue, and their gains largely add up.
papers.summary_zh: 视频语料片段检索中，强语料级排序器的高排名错误主要源于选错视频而非边界不精确，且重加权已有证据无法解决。DiTraR从两个互补方向应对视频选择：见证区间评分器将查询分解为探针并精确打分所有候选区间，多评分器能量集成在一次穷举搜索前平均多个独立训练评分器的能量，冻结语言模型作为转录验证器读取高排名视频的时间戳对话并重排片段而不改变边界。在TVR验证集上以IoU 0.5和0.7达到24.36和13.55 R@1，集成改善视觉内容查询、验证器改善对话查询且增益基本可叠加。
papers.summary_en: In video corpus moment retrieval, most top-ranked errors of a strong corpus-level scorer stem from selecting the wrong video rather than imprecise boundaries, and re-weighting existing evidence does not fix them. DiTraR addresses video selection from two complementary directions: a witness-interval scorer that decomposes the query into probes and exactly scores every candidate interval, a multi-scorer energy ensemble that averages independently trained scorers before one exhaustive search, and a frozen language-model transcript verifier that re-orders top-ranked moments using time-stamped dialogue without changing boundaries. On the TVR validation split it reaches 24.36 and 13.55 R@1 at IoU 0.5 and 0.7, with the ensemble helping visual-content queries, the verifier helping dialogue queries, and their gains largely adding up.
highlights_zh: 见证区间评分+能量集成+转录验证
视觉与对话查询增益可叠加
highlights_en: Witness-interval scoring, energy ensemble, transcript verifier
Visual and dialogue gains largely additive

papers.title: ESSI: Computationally Efficient Semantic Search for Sparse Autoencoder Concepts
papers.abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) decompose diffusion model activations into interpretable features, but steering a model with them requires identifying which features map to a given semantic concept, if any. Existing methods for this concept to feature task are expensive, relying on grid searches or repeated passes through the frozen UNet. We propose Efficient Semantic Sparse Identification (ESSI). Using segmentation masks to label SDXL activations as concept or non-concept, ESSI ranks SAE features and binary-searches for the smallest set on which a linear classifier still separates positive from negative samples while not falling below a performance threshold, then reuses that classifier to calibrate the steering strength. We evaluate the same selected features on both concept insertion and object unlearning. Compared with prior work, ESSI is as cheap or cheaper, and performs well on both insertion and removal.
papers.summary_zh: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）能将扩散模型激活分解为可解释特征，但现有“概念到特征”的匹配方法依赖网格搜索或反复通过冻结UNet，成本高昂。ESSI利用分割掩码将SDXL激活标注为概念/非概念样本，对SAE特征排序并二分搜索最小特征集，使线性分类器仍能区分正负样本且不低于性能阈值，并复用该分类器校准引导强度。在概念插入与物体遗忘任务上，ESSI成本不高于甚至低于先前方法且两项任务均表现良好，为SAE概念定位提供了高效实用的方案。
papers.summary_en: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) decompose diffusion model activations into interpretable features, but existing concept-to-feature methods are expensive, relying on grid searches or repeated passes through the frozen UNet. ESSI labels SDXL activations as concept or non-concept using segmentation masks, ranks SAE features, binary-searches for the smallest feature set on which a linear classifier still separates positives from negatives without dropping below a performance threshold, and reuses that classifier to calibrate steering strength. Evaluated on both concept insertion and object unlearning, ESSI is as cheap or cheaper than prior work and performs well on both tasks, offering an efficient and practical approach to SAE concept identification.
highlights_zh: 二分搜索最小特征集并复用分类器校准引导
插入与遗忘双任务均表现良好且成本更低
高效定位SAE概念，助力模型可控编辑

papers.title: Task2Hand: A Contact-Grounded Skill for Parametric Dexterous-Hand Morphology Design
papers.abstract: Dexterous hand design demands repeated expert work across geometry, robot-description code, collision debugging, grasp initialization, and policy training. We present Task2Hand, a Skill: a specification package that turns a functional manipulation brief into a parameterized hand model and routes every candidate through cost-ordered contact, dynamics, and learning gates. Each gate returns a status and an evidence record; on failure, the Skill records the earliest blocker, revises one bounded parameter group, and reruns the cheaper gates. The agent generates, validates, and trains autonomously within declared bounds, and escalates trade-offs, plateaus, and conflicting evidence to a human who sets the next design direction. An evidence-driven design trajectory for bidirectional in-hand manipulation yielded SAGE Hand (Skill-Aware Generative Embodiment): four fingers, 16 actuated DoF, an integrated guiding palm, compact roots, cylindrical tips, and a collision-cleared opposable thumb. Under a matched training protocol, SAGE Hand reaches 45.6% task success on a hexagonal prism against 37.3% for the LEAP hand, and 70.8% on a bicolor cylinder against 51.6%. Dense simulated tactile input more than halves the cylinder drop rate. In a controlled iteration study, the Skill path preserves capture at 164/165 trials while the path without the Skill degrades to 14/165, confirming that the gates act as a regression guard during refinement. Accepted candidates pack with URDF/MJCF, metrics, checkpoints, and a provenance manifest.
papers.summary_zh: 灵巧手设计需在几何、URDF/MJCF代码、碰撞调试、抓取初始化与策略训练间反复人工迭代，成本高且易回归。Task2Hand提出一种Skill规范包，将功能操作需求转为参数化手模型，并用按代价排序的接触、动力学与学习门控逐级验证候选，失败时记录最早阻塞点、仅修改一组有界参数并重跑廉价门控，必要时升级给人类决策。在双向手内操作任务中演化出SAGE Hand，六棱柱成功率45.6%（LEAP为37.3%）、双色圆柱70.8%（LEAP为51.6%），门控路径在迭代中保持164/165次捕获而对照组退化至14/165，证明其可作为设计精化中的回归防护。
papers.summary_en: Dexterous hand design requires repeated expert work across geometry, robot-description code, collision debugging, grasp initialization, and policy training. Task2Hand introduces a Skill specification package that converts a functional manipulation brief into a parameterized hand model and routes candidates through cost-ordered contact, dynamics, and learning gates, recording the earliest blocker, revising one bounded parameter group, and escalating trade-offs to a human when needed. The resulting SAGE Hand achieves 45.6% success on a hexagonal prism versus 37.3% for LEAP and 70.8% on a bicolor cylinder versus 51.6%, while the gated Skill path preserves capture at 164/165 trials versus 14/165 without it, showing the gates act as a regression guard during refinement.
highlights_zh: 代价排序门控+单参数组回退的自主设计闭环
门控防回归，但依赖仿真与有界参数空间

papers.title: Real-time neuromorphic audio and vision perception for autonomous robotic applications: Integration and experimental evaluation on a rover platform
papers.abstract: Neuromorphic sensing and computing offer a promising alternative to conventional deep learning pipelines for mobile robots, where perception must run continuously under tight latency and energy constraints. However, most neuromorphic solutions are still evaluated offline or on isolated benchmarks, and their integration into complete robotic systems remains largely unexplored. In this technical report, a four-wheel rover platform is presented that combines three real-time perception pipelines: a classical audio tagging pipeline based on Pretrained Audio Neural Networks (PANNs) running on an NVIDIA Jetson GPU, a neuromorphic audio pipeline in which a spiking neural network (SNN) is deployed on the SynSense Xylo Audio~2 chip, and a neuromorphic vision pipeline in which events from an event-based camera are processed by the SpikeYOLO spiking detector for traffic cone detection. On the Xylo chip, the whole processing chain---from the microphone signal to the classification of low- and high-pitched sounds---is performed on-chip, while the host only configures the device and reads the output neurons. All models are deployed as containerised services and integrated through ROS~2, and a configurable action dispatcher maps the detected classes to robot behaviours, closing the loop between perception and actuation. The platform is demonstrated in a proof-of-concept scenario in which the robot reacts to sound classes detected by both audio pipelines and detects traffic cones with the event camera, showing the feasibility of integrating neuromorphic hardware into a multimodal robotic platform operating in real time.
papers.summary_zh: 神经形态感知在移动机器人中潜力巨大，但多数方案仅在离线或孤立基准上评估，缺乏完整机器人系统集成。本文构建四轮漫游车平台，集成基于Jetson GPU的PANNs音频标记、部署于SynSense Xylo Audio 2芯片的全片上SNN音频流水线，以及SpikeYOLO处理事件相机进行锥桶检测，均以容器化服务经ROS 2集成并由可配置动作调度器闭环控制。概念验证场景中机器人实时响应两路音频分类并检测交通锥，证明了神经形态硬件融入多模态机器人平台的可行性。
papers.summary_en: Neuromorphic sensing and computing promise an alternative to conventional deep learning for mobile robots with tight latency and energy constraints, yet most solutions are evaluated offline or on isolated benchmarks and rarely integrated into complete robotic systems. This technical report presents a four-wheel rover integrating three real-time perception pipelines: a PANNs-based audio tagging pipeline on an NVIDIA Jetson GPU, a fully on-chip spiking neural network audio pipeline on the SynSense Xylo Audio 2 chip, and a SpikeYOLO event-camera detector for traffic cones, all deployed as containerised ROS 2 services with a configurable action dispatcher closing the perception-actuation loop. A proof-of-concept demonstration shows the robot reacting to sound classes from both audio pipelines and detecting traffic cones with the event camera, establishing the feasibility of integrating neuromorphic hardware into a multimodal robotic platform operating in real time.
